_readme: Short test sentences written for this test suite. Not copied from any
publication. Every one is a plain, factually empty statement chosen to
exercise a script, a terminator or a normalisation edge -- deliberately
mundane, so that no fixture asserts anything about a real place, person or
incident. Copying real reporting here would put licensed article text into
a public repository, which is the exact failure WP1's licence layer exists

en.text: The officer said the road was closed. Traffic moved slowly.

hi.text: अधिकारी ने कहा कि सड़क बंद है। यातायात धीमा रहा।

mr.text: अधिकाऱ्याने सांगितले की रस्ता बंद आहे। वाहतूक संथ होती।

bn.text: কর্মকর্তা বলেছেন রাস্তা বন্ধ ছিল। যানবাহন ধীরে চলেছে।

as.text: বিষয়াই ক'লে বাটটো বন্ধ আছিল। যান-বাহন লাহে লাহে গ'ল।

ml.text: റോഡ് അടച്ചിരുന്നു എന്ന് ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥൻ പറഞ്ഞു. ഗതാഗതം സാവധാനമായിരുന്നു.

ta.text: சாலை மூடப்பட்டதாக அதிகாரி கூறினார். போக்குவரத்து மெதுவாக இருந்தது.

te.text: రహదారి మూసివేయబడిందని అధికారి చెప్పారు. రాకపోకలు నెమ్మదిగా సాగాయి.

kn.text: ರಸ್ತೆ ಮುಚ್ಚಲಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಅಧಿಕಾರಿ ಹೇಳಿದರು. ಸಂಚಾರ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿತ್ತು.

gu.text: અધિકારીએ કહ્યું કે રસ્તો બંધ હતો. વાહનવ્યવહાર ધીમો રહ્યો.

pa.text: ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ ਕਿ ਸੜਕ ਬੰਦ ਸੀ। ਆਵਾਜਾਈ ਹੌਲੀ ਰਹੀ।

or.text: ଅଧିକାରୀ କହିଲେ ରାସ୍ତା ବନ୍ଦ ଥିଲା। ଯାନବାହନ ଧୀରେ ଚାଲିଲା।

ur.text: افسر نے کہا کہ سڑک بند تھی۔ ٹریفک آہستہ چل رہی تھی۔

mixed_script.text: पुलिस ने कहा the road was closed. यातायात धीमा रहा।
mixed_script.note: Devanagari and Latin in one sentence, as Indian reporting routinely mixes them.

repeated_substring.text: Kishtwar and Kishtwar and Kishtwar again in Kishtwar district.
repeated_substring.note: Four identical tokens: substring search would find the wrong one.

zero_width.note: Zero-width space and soft hyphen inside words.

joiner_preserved.note: ZWJ changes the conjunct; removing it would change the word.

abbreviations.text: Dr. R. K. Sharma met Shri Verma at 3.30 p.m. The meeting ended.
abbreviations.note: Honorifics, initials and a decimal must not split a sentence.

ellipsis.text: He paused... then continued speaking. The room was quiet.
ellipsis.note: A mid-sentence ellipsis is not a boundary.

danda.text: पहला वाक्य। दूसरा वाक्य॥ तीसरा वाक्य।
danda.note: Danda and double danda both terminate.

quote_with_terminator.text: "The road was closed," the officer said. Traffic resumed later.
quote_with_terminator.note: A terminator inside a quotation keeps the closing mark.
